subject: GEN3 REQUIREMENT: remove experimental mode from app
body: User decision for the next production build: remove the experimental option from the app entirely. Do not merely hide the UI toggle. The legacy/experimental execution path must be retired or made unreachable because enabling it against the current architecture could conflict with/break Gen3 runtime behavior. R&D agents should not design Gen3 around preserving compatibility with this experimental mode unless primary explicitly reverses this decision.
